notes.title: Demonbyte – Engine Upgrade *ACHIEVEMENTS possible?
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]We’ve got some huge news: [b]Demonbyte has officially been ported to the newest version of the engine we use to create Demonbyte![/b] After extensive testing, we can finally share this with you. This upgrade brings:[/p][list][*][p][b]Significant performance improvements[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Massive bug fixes and stability updates[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Support for Steam Achievements[/b] 🎉[/p][/*][/list][p]Yes, you read that right—[b]Steam Achievements are coming to Demonbyte![/b] While our current priority is finishing key features before the official launch out of Early Access, we’re excited to confirm achievements are now possible and will be implemented before 1.0. Expect that sweet dopamine pop later![/p][hr][/hr][h2]Major Gameplay Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Experimental Change – Skull Knights[/b][/p][list][*][p]Skull Knights now fire projectiles directly from their bodies (instead of from above).[/p][/*][*][p]This change is experimental and may revert if feedback (including our own) leans negative.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Community Feedback – UFO Balance[/b][/p][list][*][p]We’ve heard your frustrations about the Alien Illuminati level.[/p][/*][*][p]UFO spaceships’ damage has been nerfed from [b]32 DPS (hitscan)[/b] to [b]20 DPS (hitscan)[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Future experimental tests may give UFOs projectile-based attacks instead.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Bug Fixes & Stability[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed projectiles so they now match their intended monsters and fire correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved monster collision issues—no more clipping through walls. (still needs testing)[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed potential crashes when loading certain maps with thousands of tiles/entities.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed shader-related rendering issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed scaling issues with loading screen images at different resolutions/aspect ratios.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected entities disappearing when near closed doors.[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous fixes to editor stability, HUD behavior, and save/load edge cases.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed weapons, projectiles, decals, and doors not rendering or lighting properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Patched multiple crash scenarios during map/script loading and editor asset replacement.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Player Rotation Check[/b]: Now returns accurate values (no longer offset by 90). Existing scripts may need adjustment.[/p][/*][*][p]Decorations and enemies with [b]radius = 0[/b] will no longer interact with projectiles or players.[/p][/*][*][p]Local variables now reset properly when starting a new game or switching maps.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]General Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Spark and blood particles no longer affect custom particle effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Vsync is now always enabled in menus to prevent unnecessary GPU usage.[/p][/*][*][p]Many optimizations, with performance improvements up to [b]2x faster[/b] in some cases.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Performance[/h2][list][*][p]Improved performance for tile rendering and static 3D models.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced performance cost for key-bound scripts[/p][/*][*][p]Overall script/fsm efficiency improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple collision-related slowdowns.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Closing Notes[/h2][p]This update lays the foundation for the final stretch of Early Access. The engine upgrade not only makes Demonbyte more stable and performant but also unlocks features you’ve been asking for—[b]like achievements[/b].[/p][p]As always, thank you for your feedback and support. Keep sharing your thoughts on the new experimental changes (like the Skull Knight and UFO tweaks). Your feedback shapes Demonbyte as it evolves toward 1.0.[/p][p]Stay tuned, and happy demon-slaying![/p][p]— The Demonbyte Team[/p]

notes.title: Demonbyte Phase 2: Echoes of Mayhem
notes.notes:
[h1]Demonbyte Phase 2: [i]Echoes of Mayhem[/i] – Patch Notes[/h1][h2]Major Gameplay Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Removed Crosshair:[/b] To bring Demonbyte closer to its retro [i]boomer shooter[/i] roots, we’ve removed the crosshair. This change makes the gameplay more challenging and immersive, staying true to the classic FPS feel.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Weapon Balance Updates[/h2][list][*][p][b]Shotgun:[/b] Damage increased from [b]160 → 200[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Assault Rifle 47:[/b] Damage increased from [b]66 → 89[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Demonbeam Gun Ammo:[/b] Fixed an issue where ammo pickups only granted 1 charge. They now correctly provide a full 100-charge battery.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Collision Issues:[/b] Addressed several cases where monsters could clip through walls or shoot the player through invisible surfaces. (Further testing and fixes are ongoing.)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1]New Content: [i]Echoes of Mayhem[/i][/h1][p]This Weapon wasn’t originally on our roadmap—but we loved how it turned out and wanted to surprise you![/p][list][*][p][b]New Weapon – Scythe:[/b] A powerful melee weapon with the highest damage in the game so far. Its slower attack speed keeps it balanced within the arsenal.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Cutscenes:[/b] Additional story and satire cutscenes have been added (though we’re still behind schedule here).[/p][/*][*][p][b]8 New Enemy Types:[/b] Expect fresh challenges and gameplay shakeups—you’ll discover them as you explore![/p][/*][*][p][b]5 Brand-New Levels:[/b] With these additions, Demonbyte now features [b]20 total levels[/b], fulfilling our Phase 2 milestone.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanded Voice Parody Moments:[/b] More humorous voice lines have been sprinkled in, with plans to expand this even further in future updates.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Text-Based Parody Additions:[/b] A few new tongue-in-cheek moments added throughout the game.[/p][/*][/list][quote][p][i]Note:[/i] The planned “Secret Routes to Unlock Early Weapons” feature has been moved to a future update. Stay tuned![/p][/quote][hr][/hr][h1]What’s Next After Phase 2[/h1][p]Reaching Phase 2 marks a big milestone, and here’s what’s ahead:[/p][list][*][p][b]Engine Upgrade Testing:[/b] We’ll begin testing Demonbyte on the newest version of our engine. This update promises better stability, performance improvements, and new features.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Future Updates (if stable):[/b][/p][list][*][p]More parody voice lines.[/p][/*][*][p]Additional secret areas and puzzles to discover.[/p][/*][*][p]Potential “puzzle-style” secrets (complete tasks to unlock powerful weapons early).[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Once this work is complete, we’ll shift focus toward [b]Phase 3[/b] content. For details on Phase 3, check our previously posted roadmap.[/p][hr][/hr][h1]Stay Connected[/h1][p]For more updates, discussions, and to share your feedback, you can find us here:[/p][list][*][p][b]Steam Discussions Forum[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Official Discord:[/b] [url="https://discord.gg/4vvJpVPKEB"]Join Here[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you all for your continued support as we shape Demonbyte into something truly special.[/p][p][b]– Huskey & Could Care Less Studios[/b]
CEO[/p]

notes.title: ⚙️ Engine Upgrade + Compatibility Update
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We’re excited to announce that [i]Demonbyte[/i] has been [b]successfully ported to the newest version of the engine we use[/b]! This wasn’t just a routine upgrade—it’s packed with long-requested features, bug fixes, performance enhancements, and improvements that many players (and fellow devs from other engine-built games) have been asking for.[/p][p]While this patch doesn’t include [i]new content[/i], it lays the groundwork for a much smoother and more customizable experience moving forward. Here’s what’s changed:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🚀 Major Engine Features Now Live in [i]Demonbyte[/i][/h3][list][*][p][b]Instant Resolution Switching[/b] — No more needing to restart the game just to apply resolution changes. Change it, and it sticks immediately. 🎉[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mouse Invert Options (X/Y)[/b] — For the rare few who like their controls spicy, we now support full mouse X and Y inversion options.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Mouse Movement[/b] — Mouse input is now much more consistent and uses raw input for smoother camera control.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧱 General Fixes & Polishes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Company Splash Screen Fixed[/b] — A minor issue, but it bugged a few of you (and us), so we knocked it out while we were under the hood.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Menu GUI Text Color Changed[/b] — Swapped the harsh yellow text back to [b]white[/b] for improved readability and accessibility.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🛠 Compatibility & Save Support[/h3][list][*][p]All saves made in [b]previous versions[/b] should be fully compatible.[/p][/*][*][p]Broken/crashing saves should now [b]load properly[/b] without crashing.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]✨ Additional Engine Enhancements[/h3][list][*][p]Per-map light baking into vertex colors (for performance with dense lighting).[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded keybind support (some bindings now properly save and persist).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]⚙️ Performance Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Faster entity collision/movement[/p][/*][*][p]Better handling of weapon sprites[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized decals, particles, and skyboxes[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced FPS drops[/p][/*][*][p]Better performance for sequences and logic[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧯 Massive Bug Squash[/h3][p]This engine update comes with [b]dozens of bug fixes[/b], including:[/p][list][*][p]Weapon flickering with multiple lights[/p][/*][*][p]Resolution scaling/rendering issues[/p][/*][*][p]Projectiles phasing through enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Crash fixes related to saving, loading, models, and particles[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes for improperly saved scripted light/weapon settings[/p][/*][*][p]Muzzleflash, draw/holster, and weapon state syncing[/p][/*][*][p]Transparent particle rendering problems[/p][/*][*][p]Dozens of crash scenarios now handled gracefully[/p][/*][/list][p]For the full list of tech-side fixes (and there’s a lot), join our Discord![/p][hr][/hr][h3]💬 Final Notes from [i]Could Care Less[/i][/h3][p]This update wasn’t about new content—it was about [b]setting the foundation[/b]. Future patches will now benefit from a more stable, powerful, and player-friendly engine.[/p][p]As always, thanks for playing [i]Demonbyte[/i]. Your support keeps the chaos flowing.[/p][p]— [i]The Could Care Less Dev Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: 🔥 Demonbyte – Phase 1 Major Update: Foundations of Chaos 🔥
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Slayers,[/p][p]Phase 1 of our [i]Demonbyte[/i] roadmap is here—and it’s a big one. We’ve been hard at work pushing new content, patching up bugs, and adding in a few chaotic surprises to keep things spicy. This marks a major step forward in our Early Access journey, and we’re excited to finally bring you the [b]Foundations of Chaos[/b] update![/p][p]As promised, we’ve delivered 3+ new weapons in this phase. In fact, we added a fourth because... well, we [i]could care less[/i] about limits when chaos is involved.[/p][p][b]🆕 New Weapons Added:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Sword & Shield[/b] – Get defensive and bash demons up close.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crossbow[/b] – Silent, deadly, and built for those who like precision.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dinosaur Egg[/b] [i](Easter Egg Weapon)[/i] – Yes, you read that right. Find it, throw it, splat it![/p][/*][*][p][b]DemonBeemGun[/b] – It hums, it beams, it melts. Enough said.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🌍 5 New Levels:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Phase 1 promised 5 levels, and we delivered—bringing the total count to [b]15 levels[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level 11[/b] is now fully finished (it used to cut off midway—no more!).[/p][/*][*][p]These levels are packed with traps, ambushes, and all the demon-slaying mayhem you've come to expect.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]👹 New Boss: The Demonlord[/b][/p][list][*][p]It’s time to face a new nightmare. Prepare for a climactic fight with the [b]Demonlord[/b], our most chaotic boss yet.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🎬 New Cutscenes & Story Moments:[/b][/p][list][*][p]A brand-new story cutscene has been added to expand the lore.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple mini-cutscenes added for immersion and narrative flavor.[/p][/*][*][p][b]4 new parody voiceovers[/b] to give you that signature [i]Demonbyte[/i] humor.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🕵️ Secret Content:[/b][/p][list][*][p]A new [b]parody Easter egg[/b] has been hidden inside one of the levels. If you know, you know. 😉[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed various wall glitches where players could get stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved issues with monsters phasing into walls (this may still require future polish).[/p][/*][*][p]Player no longer spawns facing the wall in Level 7. (You’re welcome.)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🎁 Surprise Reveal![/h3][p]We’ve tucked a [b]very special surprise[/b] into this update. It's not a weapon, it's not a spoof—it’s something [i]much bigger[/i] and more meta than that. Play the game, explore a bit, and you might just stumble upon an [b]announcement[/b] from [i]Could Care Less[/i] that changes what’s coming next…[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thanks for sticking with us through Early Access! We’re building [i]Demonbyte[/i] with passion, chaos, and the help of our awesome community. This Phase 1 update lays down the foundation—but we’ve only just begun.[/p][p]Stay tuned. Stay chaotic.
— [i]The Could Care Less Team[/i] 🧨[/p]

notes.title: DEMONBYTE IS LIVE! | Early Access Launch
notes.notes:
[p]The wait is over — [b]Demonbyte[/b] is officially available now in Early Access![/p][p]We've been dying to unleash this chaotic, over-the-top shooter into the world, and there's no better time than now, especially with the [b]Steam Summer Sale[/b] in full swing. To celebrate the launch we're offering [b]25% off Demonbyte[/b] for a limited time during the sale.[/p][p]Whether you're a fan of wild weapons, demonic enemy hordes, or secret-filled levels that mash up everything you love about retro shooters and parody-filled chaos, [i]Demonbyte[/i] is ready to deliver.[/p][p][/p][p]Demonbyte is a game that thrives on creative experimentation, player feedback, and absurdity. Early Access gives us the space to grow [i]with you[/i], delivering content in phases as we build toward our full 1.0 vision.[/p][p]This isn’t just a drip feed of filler — each content phase brings [b]major new features[/b], [b]levels[/b], [b]weapons[/b], [b]Easter eggs[/b], and [b]ridiculous surprises[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Here’s What You Can Expect: Our Roadmap to 1.0[/b][/p][p]We’ve prepared a full [b]Roadmap[/b] to keep you in the loop and let you know what’s cooking behind the scenes. Take a look:[/p][p]🩸 [b]Foundations of Chaos[/b]
🔹 3+ New Weapons (2 hidden as Easter eggs)
🔹 Voiceover system expansion
🔹 First round of parody dialogue & humorous content
🔹 Development begins on new levels (target: Level 15+)
🔹 Hints of hidden dino-based destruction... 🦖[/p][p]💀 [b]Echoes of Mayhem[/b]
🔹 More cutscenes for story & satire
🔹 New enemy types & gameplay shakeups
🔹 Secret routes to unlock early weapons
🔹 Expanded voice parody moments
🔹 Content push toward 20 total levels[/p][p]🌀 [b]Dimensional Merge[/b]
🔹 Merging elements from older levels into wild new ones
🔹 Off-track paths, hidden guns, game-breaking surprises
🔹 More layered maps and asset mashups
🔹 More ridiculous Easter eggs (some just for laughs, some not)[/p][p]🎯 [b]FULL RELEASE – Version 1.0[/b]
🔹 Target: 24 levels (maybe 30!)
🔹 Final round of content: cutscenes, enemies, weapons
🔹 Fully voiced parody campaign
🔹 All systems and secrets polished[/p][p]🍾 [b]Completion[/b]
🔹 Price raise
🔹 Full release
🔹 Time to pop champagne & begin the next crazy project[/p][p]📷 [i](See full visual roadmap below for details!)[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578521/ebccc594a29a690789c03358a3428df87242450e.png"][/img][/p][p]This is just the beginning — grab Demonbyte now and help shape the madness.[/p][p]                                                                         — The [i]Could Care Less[/i] Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: 🎮 DEMONBYTE DEMO IS HERE – PLAY NOW! 🎮
notes.notes:
[b]This is a huge step for our team[/b], and we're thrilled to finally let you get your hands on what we've been working so hard on. From retro-inspired chaos to explosive sci-fi mayhem, Demonbyte aims to bring back the fun and attitude of classic boomer shooters—with a modern, demonic twist.

💬 [b]We want your feedback![/b]
Whether it’s a bug, a gameplay thought, or just some love, your voice helps shape this game.

📣 [b]You can join the discussion in two ways:[/b]

[b]Our official Discord server[/b] – for real-time feedback, updates, and community:
👉 [url=https://discord.gg/4vvJpVPKEB]Discord[/url]

[b]Steam Forums[/b] – if Discord isn't your thing, we’re just as active here on Steam and always listening.

[b]This demo is just a taste of what’s coming[/b]. We’re committed to finishing this game and bringing the full chaotic vision of Demonbyte to life. Thank you for playing, sharing, and supporting!

[i][u][b]Good or bad—we make games.[/b][/u][/i]
